prompt: Create a technical test scaffold for an accounting app with a dashboard, a double-entry ledger, and backend services. Include a README describing the goals to finish the scaffold, fix errors, un-slop the UI, and deploy to Render/AWS/GCP/Azure. Candidates may use AI but must log prompts and build sub-agents.
summary: Created pnpm/Turborepo monorepo: apps/web (Vite+React+Tailwind v4), apps/ledger-api and apps/reporting-api (Hono), packages/shared (money + reporting engine), packages/db (Drizzle Postgres + in-memory adapters), packages/ui (design system). Added Dockerfiles, render.yaml, cloud notes, AI log tooling, and starter sub-agents.

task: Scope down to a scaffold and add real-database options
prompt: No need to build the full app, just scaffold is okay. Mention using a real database like PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.
summary: Kept the dashboard pages intentionally minimal but compiling, and documented PostgreSQL (wired), MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite/libSQL and SQL Server as acceptable options behind the LedgerRepository port in docs/DATABASE.md. Added TODO(candidate) markers instead of building the full product.

task: Apply anti-slop design rules to the design system
prompt: Build the shared UI primitives so the dashboard looks like a product, not a template: one accent colour, no icon-in-rounded-square, no glassmorphism, no gradients, tabular money columns.
summary: packages/ui primitives use a zinc neutral base with a single indigo accent and semantic emerald/amber/red for state only. Icons are limited to navigation/actions via lucide-react. Stat has no decorative icon. docs/DESIGN.md records the enforced rules.

task: Verify typecheck, tests, build and runtime
prompt: Run pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build, then smoke-test the built services and the internal-token boundary.
summary: Fixed real errors found: TS 'wholePart possibly undefined', Card title type clash, zod output typing in route validators, undici Response.json() typed as unknown in tests, tsup --no-external CLI misuse, and a node:crypto import that broke the browser bundle. All green; built APIs returned balanced trial balance and /api/internal returned 401 without the bearer token.

prompt: Create a PDF of guides for this technical test.
summary: Added scripts/build-guide.mjs: renders the markdown docs (README + docs/*.md) into a styled A4 HTML guide, then prints it with headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol to get a 'Page N of M' footer. Built-in TOC (marked no longer emits heading ids, so the contents page is generated from the section list). Output: docs/ledgerlab-technical-test-guide.pdf (27 pages). Added pnpm guide:pdf and guide:html.

task: Add the client story (Warung Books) and fold it into the guide
prompt: Add a story: we have a client with a vibe-coded app who needs to go production scale.
summary: Wrote docs/CLIENT-STORY.md: Warung Books, a seed-stage bookkeeping app built by a non-technical founder with an AI app builder, now with 1,400 paying customers, a CPA review, a bank vendor security review and a seed round. Mapped each inherited defect to the challenge suite and to goals G0-G8, with KPIs, stakeholders, constraints and risks. Linked it from README and TASKS, and made it Part 1 of the guide with a new cover.

task: Add infrastructure plan and next-phase plan as scored deliverables
prompt: Need candidate to define infrastructure plan as well and planning for next development phase.
summary: Added two scored goals: G9 infrastructure plan (topology, environments, compute/scaling, RPO/RTO with a performed restore drill, networking/edge, secrets, CI/CD rollback, SLOs, cost model at 1x/3x/10x, failure modes, ADRs) and G10 next-phase development plan (measurable outcomes, RICE prioritisation, three milestones with exit criteria, capacity and next hires, workstreams, risks, metrics, explicit deferrals). Shipped both as fill-in templates, rebalanced the rubric to 100 with the two new criteria, extended TASKS, SUBMISSION and the client-story mandate table, and added them as Parts 10-11 of the guide (now 43 pages).

task: Containerize the monorepo with Docker (dev hot reload + prod images)
prompt: first we containerize this application with docker. my expectation: have dockerfile; have docker-compose.dev.yml (for local development, I expect have hot reload whenever the code changes); have docker-compose.yml (for prod/staging I expect we build the image first, then start the builded image); have ./run-dev.sh to run all services and apps in development mode, so I dont need docker compose -f .. again. don't forget to log this prompt
summary: Added root multi-stage Dockerfile (targets dev/tools/ledger-api/reporting-api/web; pnpm deploy for prod-only node_modules, non-root, tini, healthchecks), .dockerignore, docker-compose.dev.yml (bind-mounted source, polling watchers, Postgres + migrate/seed init), docker-compose.yml (build-then-run images, required secrets via :? interpolation, Postgres not published, migrate job, optional seed profile), run-dev.sh wrapper. Made seed-cli skip journal entries when some already exist so repeated dev starts do not duplicate data. Verified: docker compose build succeeded; prod stack all healthy, ledger /health reports repository=postgres, seed ran; dev stack up, editing health.ts hot-reloaded ledger-api (version change visible without restart), web 200 on :5173. Legacy deployment/Dockerfile.* left untouched since render.yaml and cloud docs reference them.

task: Setup Kubernetes deployment with Traefik ingress and deploy-k8s CLI
prompt: setup kubernetes manifests in deployment/k8s/ with .gading.dev domain routing for web, ledger-api, and reporting-api. connect them to our existing homelab sandbox postgres on port 5433 instead of deploying in-cluster postgres. ensure ingress routes through our traefik k3s homelab cluster. read .env for secrets and create a unified ./deploy-k8s <app_name> deployment CLI like the one in nouverse-core to build amd64 images, distribute them to worker nodes, sync secrets, and perform rollouts. don't forget to log this prompt
summary: Added deployment/k8s/ manifests (namespace, ledger-api, reporting-api, web with Traefik ingress for *.gading.dev, db migration job), connected to homelab sandbox Postgres on 10.18.1.103:5433, and created executable ./deploy-k8s CLI wrapper supporting granular app deployment (all, migrate, ledger-api, reporting-api, web). Reads .env for cluster secrets, builds platform linux/amd64 images, distributes to K3s worker containerd runtimes via hub host, applies manifests, and verifies rollouts.

task: Configure GHCR container registry in CI and make deploy-k8s CLI agnostic
prompt: push container images to GitHub Container Registry under https://github.com/gadingnst/ledgerlab-scaffold. setup a GitHub Actions CI workflow to build and publish all images (tools, ledger-api, reporting-api, web) automatically, and refactor deploy-k8s.sh to be completely device-agnostic for any environment with K8s access.
summary: Configured GitHub Actions CI workflow to build multi-target Docker images (tools, ledger-api, reporting-api, web) and publish to GHCR upon main branch pushes. Refactored deploy-k8s.sh to be platform-agnostic using standard kubectl and optional GHCR pull secrets, decoupling execution from local environments and jump hosts. Updated Kubernetes manifests with GHCR registry references.

task: Migrate web frontend to Cloudflare Pages on account@gading.dev
prompt: migrate the web frontend deployment to Cloudflare Pages under the account@gading.dev account. connect it to the repository, attach the custom domain ledgerlab.gading.dev with appropriate SPA client routing rules, and point API endpoints to the live services.
summary: Created and configured Cloudflare Pages project ledgerlab under account@gading.dev linked to the GitHub repository. Attached custom domain ledgerlab.gading.dev with proxied CNAME DNS records. Added apps/web/public/_redirects for client-side SPA routing, and configured build-time production API environment variables.

task: Add backend target to deploy-k8s.sh CLI
prompt: add a backend target parameter to deploy-k8s.sh to selectively run database migrations and deploy only the backend microservices (ledger-api and reporting-api) without modifying the web frontend.
summary: Added granular backend deployment target to deploy-k8s.sh CLI to run database migration jobs and roll out ledger-api and reporting-api services while skipping frontend pods. Updated CLI usage documentation and help output.
